'''Frex Junara''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He served the Empire for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], including after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and eventually became an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Bombardier/Legends|bombardier]]. Due to his love of destroying things, Junara avoided being promoted out of his position as an ace bombardier.

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]], Frex Junara lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He fought for the Empire for [[Standard year/Legends|years]],<ref name="SWGTCG" /> including during the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Time">The ''[[Champions of the Force]]'' set involves events after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], since the post-[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] capture of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]] from ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' was referenced in the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] campaign, which was roughly concurrent to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] campaign. Therefore, this article places Frex Junara in the [[Rebellion era]] because the player could use Junara in the dark-side campaign.</ref> in which the Rebels destroyed the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> At some point during his career, Junara became an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Bombardier/Legends|bombardier]]. Due to the enjoyment he found in destroying things as an ace bombardier, Junara avoided being promoted to a different position twice over his career.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

==Personality and traits==
Frex Junara had fair skin. He was skilled enough at his duties to become an ace bombardier, which he viewed as the perfect role engaging in destruction&mdash;an activity that Junara loved. His desire to blow things up was strong enough to cause him to avoid promotions in order to continue as a bombardier.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

==Equipment==
As a bombardier, Frex Junara wore a [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] that featured an [[Armored flight suit|armored]] chest plate, [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] with a visor that covered his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] while leaving the rest of his face and neck exposed.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frex Junara appeared in [[2008]] as part of [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']], the first card set for the virtual ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'', created by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment to supplement<ref name="ChampionsSet">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]]&mdash;[[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']]</ref> the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> which was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Junara was featured on the "Ace Imperial Bombardier" card, which was illustrated by artist [[Sunder Raj Kali Kavandan]].<ref name="SWGTCG" />
